attempt.title: Andika igerageza ryo kuvugana
attempt.intro: Andika buri gerageza ryo kugera ku murwayi, n'iyo ritagenze neza.
attempt.phoneSimulated: Guhamagara kuri telefoni ni ikigereranyo muri iyi demo — nta guhamagara gukorwa.
attempt.noteHint: Bivuge mu magambo make kandi y'ukuri. Ntukandike indwara wakekaga.
attempt.reachedHint: Kugera ku murwayi bishyira iki gikorwa muri "Yavuganywe".

outcome.title: Andika umusaruro
outcome.attendedHint: Umurwayi yitabiriye gahunda cyangwa uruzinduko yoherejwemo.
outcome.noDestination: Nta hantu yoherejwe hari kuri iki gikoresho
outcome.referredCaption: Umuganga ni we wemeza ko kohereza byarangiye.
outcome.unableCaption: Umugenzuzi wawe cyangwa umuganga ni bo bazafata icyemezo gikurikira.
outcome.inlineAttemptHint: Ribikwa nk'igerageza "Ntiyabonetse" ku gihe kiri hejuru, mbere y'umusaruro.
outcome.noteHint: Bivuge mu magambo make kandi y'ukuri. Ntukandike indwara wakekaga.

errors.conflict: Iki gikorwa cyahindutse kuva wagifungura. Nta cyasimbujwe — subira inyuma ugifungure bundi bushya.
errors.failed: Ntibyabashije kubikwa kuri iki gikoresho. Ongera ugerageze.

blocked.completed: Iri kurikirana ryarangiye. Nta wundi musaruro ushobora kwandikwa.
blocked.needs_reached_attempt: Banza wandike igerageza ryo kuvugana aho umurwayi yabonetse mbere yo kwemeza ko yitabiriye.
blocked.already_unable_to_reach: "Ntibyashobotse kumubona" byamaze kwandikwa. Umugenzuzi wawe cyangwa umuganga ni bo bazafata icyemezo.
blocked.already_referred_onward: "Yoherejwe ahandi" byamaze kwandikwa kuri iki gikorwa.
blocked.not_allowed: Uyu musaruro ntushobora kwandikwa kuri iki gikorwa uko kimeze ubu.

notAccepted.title: Ntibyemewe na seriveri y'ikigereranyo
notAccepted.body: Iki gikorwa ntikigushinzwe cyangwa kiri hanze y'ivuriro ryawe. Inyandiko yawe ibitswe kuri iki gikoresho.
